info.name: SMART Health IT Sandbox FHIR APIs Bulk Data API
Start a system-level bulk export (Bulk Data server only)

params.name: _outputFormat
params.description: Requested bulk output format; defaults to application/fhir+ndjson.

params.name: _type
params.description: Comma-separated FHIR resource types to include in the export.

params.name: _since
params.description: Only include resources modified after this instant.

items.docs: Kicks off an asynchronous export of all resources on the reference Bulk Data server (https://bulk-data.smarthealthit.org/fhir). Requires the Prefer respond-async header and a SMART Backend Services access token. Responds 202 with a Content-Location status URL to poll (honor Retry-After); when complete, the status endpoint returns a manifest of NDJSON file URLs to download.
